label: Google Display & Video 360
terms_note: API requires an existing DV360 user profile with Admin, Standard or Read-only permissions on the partner/advertiser.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Google Cloud project, scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/display-video) — user profile in DV360 with Admin / Standard / Read only permission
sdks: https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/samples (Google API client libraries — Samples and libraries section)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Display & Video 360 API v4 + Bid Manager API for reports).
auth: 1. A DV360 Admin creates a user profile for the Google account (Admin / Standard / Read only on the partner or advertiser).
2. Create a Google Cloud project, enable the Display & Video 360 API, create OAuth 2.0 credentials ("Generate credentials" step); scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/display-video`.
3. Bearer access token on every call; quotas are per Cloud project.

endpoints.call: advertisers.campaigns` create / get / list / patch / delete
endpoints.notes: displayName, entityStatus, campaignGoal, campaignFlight{plannedSpendAmountMicros, plannedDates}, frequencyCap

endpoints.purpose: insertion orders (budget segments, pacing, bid strategy)
endpoints.notes: budget{budgetUnit, budgetSegments[]}, pacing{pacingPeriod, pacingType, dailyMaxMicros}, bidStrategy, kpi

endpoints.call: advertisers.lineItems` create / list / patch / bulkUpdate / duplicate · `bulkEditAssignedTargetingOptions
endpoints.purpose: line items: flight, budget, bid, targeting
endpoints.notes: lineItemType, flight, budget{budgetAllocationType, maxAmount}, pacing, bidStrategy{fixedBid{bidAmountMicros} / maximizeSpendAutoBid / performanceGoalAutoBid}, targetingExpansion, creativeIds[]
displayName, adGroupFormat, bidStrategy, targeting; adGroupAd{displayName, adUrls, videoAd / displayAd}
media upload (multipart), creativeType, dimensions, assets[{asset{mediaId}, role}], exitEvents[]
metadata{dataRange, format}, params{type, groupBys[], filters[], metrics[]}, schedule

endpoints.purpose: Floodlight / offline conversions live in Campaign Manager 360 API, not DV360

reference.limits: - Per-project quotas listed on "API limits and quotas" (requests per minute per project and per user; TODO(verify) numbers). Free API; DV360 contract + fees through Google / agency.
mcp_sdk: Google API client libraries (Java, Python, PHP, .NET …) via "Samples and libraries". No official MCP server.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id of a Google Cloud project with the Display & Video 360 API enabled.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from Google's consent flow with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/display-video, for a user with a DV360 user profile (Admin/Standard for writes).

config_fields.name: partner_id
config_fields.help: DV360 partner id whose advertisers list_accounts returns (GET /v4/advertisers requires partnerId).

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: DV360 advertiser id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /v4/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns/{campaignId}).

me.note: GET /v4/partners?pageSize=1: confirms the token and DV360 access ({partners: [{partnerId, displayName, entityStatus}]}).

list_accounts.note: GET /v4/advertisers?partnerId={partner_id config}: the partner's advertisers. Only the first page is returned (pageToken paging).

list_campaigns.note: GET /v4/advertisers/{account_id}/campaigns (account_id = advertiser id). `status` is active, paused or archived (archived campaigns are hidden unless asked for). Planned budgets are in raw.campaignBudgets (budgetAmountMicros over a date range); start/end are {year, month, day} objects. First page only.

pause_resume.note: PATCH /v4/advertisers/{advertiser_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id}?updateMask=entityStatus {entityStatus: ENTITY_STATUS_PAUSED|ENTITY_STATUS_ACTIVE}. Resuming lets its insertion orders spend again.

not_offered.get_report: DV360 reporting runs through the Bid Manager API as asynchronous queries (create a query, run it, poll the report and download a CSV file; https://developers.google.com/bid-manager/guides/get-started/overview); the runtime has no report polling or CSV download.
not_offered.update_budget: DV360 campaign budgets are planned amounts over a date range (campaignBudgets[].budgetAmountMicros, https://developers.google.com/display-video/api/reference/rest/v4/advertisers.campaigns); spend is paced on insertion orders and line items, and there is no campaign daily budget.
